key_point: The Pokémon that was never supposed to exist
title: The Pokémon that was never supposed to exist
caption: Mew was secretly added to the first Pokémon games at the last minute. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #pokemon #gamefreak

instagram.caption:
Mew was never meant to be in Pokémon Red and Green.

Near the end, programmer Shigeki Morimoto used a tiny bit of leftover memory to add Mew quietly, without most of the team knowing.

When a magazine gave away 20 Mew in a contest, kids went wild, and the secret helped make Pokémon a phenomenon.
